scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT artifacts is infeasible; T0 compare against paper-reported values is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold band gaps and orbital character strings
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: HSE06+SOC band structure values (2.52 eV indirect, 2.64 eV direct) and projected orbital descriptions
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper conclusions and figure captions; exact values as reported.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers; exactly what the reference solve.sh writes, ensuring full reward reachability.

outputs.description: Indirect band gap (Gamma to A) and direct band gap (Gamma to Gamma) computed from HSE06+SOC DFT band structure.
Dominant orbital character of the valence band maximum and conduction band minimum, e.g., Bi 6s and Br 4p for VBM, Bi p for CBM.

output_contract.notes: The paper also reports optical absorption spectrum and phonon dispersion; these are not required for the core electronic structure reproduction. The agent must use HSE06 functional with spin-orbit coupling.
